# hey_roaring

Compressed 32-bit integer sets (Roaring bitmaps) for Hey, over the pinned CRoaring 5.2.3 library.

Build and test with `bin/check`. Release with `bin/bump patch`, `bin/release`, then `bin/publish`. Published package versions are immutable.

See [Getting started](GETTING_STARTED.md), [Design](DESIGN.md), [Testing](TESTING.md) and [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md).
